title: BlackRose's Panorama
description: A resource pack that adds a custom panorama screen for Minecraft
body:
# Welcome to BlackRose's Panorama

A resource pack created by [BlackRose](https://modrinth.com/user/BlackRose) himself. The resource pack is all about changing the Panorama to one of my survival worlds. As of right now, the resource pack uses **Vanilla Tweaks** as its template to make it work

---

The resource pack and what it is about are very clear and straightforward, with its name: *BlackRose's* **Panorama**, so it changes only the panorama, nothing else

## Credits towards: [Vanilla Tweaks](https://vanillatweaks.net/)

The **cannot** rule: restrict access or sell any pack that includes our tweaks through donations and/or a paywall.

So I will make the resource pack use the license: **ARR** or **All Rights Reserved**
